title: Appassuto
text: 4 Pañcahi Anuruddha dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo || la || nirayam upapajjati || katamehi pañcahi || || 5 Assaddho ca hoti ahiriko ca hoti anottāpī ca hoti appassuto ca hoti duppañño ca hoti || || 6 Imehi kho Anuruddha pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo || la || nirayam upapajjatī ti || ||
